Download data from the Malaria Cell Atlas

Source: R/easyMCA.R
easyMCA.Rd

Download an MCA dataset archive, or read a locally available ZIP archive, and import the requested metadata or expression table.

Usage

easyMCA(url, type = "data", timeout = 300)

Arguments

url

URL of an MCA ZIP archive (for example, one returned by listMCA()), or the path to a local ZIP archive.

type

Character string specifying the table to import: "data" (cell metadata; default), "exp" (processed expression values), or "raw" (raw counts).

timeout

Download timeout in seconds (default: 300). This applies only to remote URLs; the previous R timeout option is restored on exit.

Value

A data.frame containing the selected table, with the first CSV column used as row names. For expression tables, genes are expected to occupy rows and cells columns, as provided by the MCA download.

Details

Only the requested CSV file is extracted, into an isolated temporary directory. Temporary files are removed when the function exits, including if an error occurs. Local input ZIP archives are never deleted. The supported archive members end in -data.csv, -exp.csv, or -raw.csv (also accepting underscore separators and .csv.gz).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
url <- "https://www.malariacellatlas.org/downloads/pf-ch10x-set4-biorxiv.zip"

metadata <- easyMCA(url, type = "data")
expression <- easyMCA(url, type = "exp")
raw_counts <- easyMCA(url, type = "raw")

# An already downloaded archive can also be used offline.
metadata <- easyMCA("path/to/pf-ch10x-set4-biorxiv.zip", "data")

# When creating a Seurat object, check that cells match and
# convert the counts data frame to a numeric matrix.
stopifnot(all(colnames(raw_counts) %in% rownames(metadata)))
seurat_obj <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = as.matrix(raw_counts),
  meta.data = metadata[colnames(raw_counts), , drop = FALSE],
  project = "MCA"
)
} # }
